headline: Sales surge on acquisition; profit dips, EPS outlook raised
summary_short: Abbott reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $12.593 billion, up 13.0% y/y on the Exact Sciences acquisition, while GAAP diluted EPS fell to $0.53 (-47.8% y/y net earnings) on acquisition-related amortization and financing costs; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.31 rose 4.0% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue rose 13.0% y/y ($12.593B, +4.8% comparable) on the March Exact Sciences acquisition, with Diagnostics up 42.3% reported and Medical Devices up 8.4% comparable; Nutrition fell 3.6% comparable on soft volumes. GAAP diluted EPS fell 47.8% (net earnings basis) y/y to $0.53 on higher intangible amortization ($658M, +56.8% y/y) and acquisition financing interest expense; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.31 rose 4.0% y/y. Abbott raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $5.45-$5.60 and reaffirmed 6.5%-7.5% comparable sales growth, guiding Q3 adjusted EPS to $1.38-$1.46. The company returned $2.1B to shareholders via dividends and buybacks, including a $0.63/share quarterly dividend.

drivers.explanation: Growth was driven by the March 2026 Exact Sciences acquisition (Cancer Diagnostics), 42.3% reported Diagnostics growth, and 8.4% comparable Medical Devices growth; Nutrition fell 3.6% comparable on lower volumes.
Decline driven by higher intangible amortization ($658M, +56.8% y/y) from the Exact Sciences deal, acquisition financing interest expense, and net tax items versus a smaller benefit a year ago.
Operating earnings fell as higher amortization, R&D, and SG&A (including acquisition integration costs) outpaced 13.0% reported sales growth.
Adjusted EPS growth is explained by excluding the same specified items (amortization, acquisition costs, legal reserves) that depressed GAAP EPS; underlying adjusted earnings grew modestly y/y.

Abbott raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $5.45-$5.60 (from $5.38-$5.58) and reaffirmed 6.5%-7.5% comparable sales growth, citing momentum expected to drive accelerating sales and earnings growth in the second half.
